_overridesNote.@softarc/native-federation: MUST be a subset of the range @angular-architects/native-federation depends on (~4.5.0 at 22.1.2; it was ^4.4.0 at 22.1.1), and MUST be bumped together with the angular group. The override exists to collapse the tree onto one copy: without it the hoisted copy is older than the one @angular-architects nests. ENFORCED by scripts/check-nf-override.mjs (npm run check:nf-override) -- read that file before touching this value; it also prints every OTHER consumer the override is applied to. DO NOT TRUST GREEN CI ALONE FOR THIS PIN, AND DO NOT TRUST THE PRODUCTION BUILD: measured on this repo, an override of 4.4.1 under a consumer requiring ~4.5.0 installs with no ERESOLVE (npm applies overrides without resolution), passes the unit suite, AND passes `ng build --configuration production` -- on the committed lockfile and on a full fresh re-resolve alike. The build only fails once the pin is stale enough to break the /internal export surface (4.3.2 under 22.1.x dies with "does not provide an export named 'isUnderAnyDir'"), which is one or more bumps AFTER the drift was introduced. That is how this pin rotted to 4.3.2 while 22.1.1 had moved to ^4.4.0. check:nf-override is what fires at the bump that introduces the drift. SECOND CONSUMER, knowingly violated: @softarc/native-federation-node@4.0.0 requires @softarc/native-federation at EXACTLY 4.1.3, and this override forces it past that, tree-wide and silently. Tolerated only because native-federation-node is imported nowhere in this repo (package.json and README prose only) and npm marks it end-of-life in favour of @softarc/native-federation-orchestrator, which is already in the tree. Deleting that dead dependency would remove the need for this override entirely -- see issue link in the PR that added this note. A stale pin can also fail SILENTLY at runtime: 22.1.2 injects a watchpack-backed watcher via the `watch` option of createNfWatcher, an option that only exists from 4.5.0 (verified absent from 4.4.1), so under a 4.4.x pin the injected watcher is discarded with no error and watch mode quietly falls back to the old fs path. Dependabot CANNOT bump this for you -- it only rewrites an override whose value literally matches the old dependency range, and a bare pin like 4.4.1 never matches ^4.4.0, so it is left behind silently. Check this value by hand on every angular group bump.
